## Checklist

- [ ] Branch named `<type>/<issue>-<description>`
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added/updated (unit and/or e2e)
- [ ] No sensitive data (secrets, `.env`, tokens, passwords) in the diff
- [ ] Authorization is enforced on the backend (never UI-only)
- [ ] SQL migration included if the schema changes
